{{Infobox Item |name= |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Ancient Spear Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Ancient Spear Icon.png }} |caption= |game= BotW |other= |cost= |value= |location= [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]] |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Extra damage against [[Guardian]]s }} |strength= 30 |durability= 50 |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Ancient Spear|Ancient Spears|Series, BotW|plural}} are [[Item]]s in {{BotW}}. ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 30 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Spear}} Ancient Spears are [[Weapon]]s that can be made at the [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]] using the [[Ancient Oven]]. To make one, [[Link]] will need to provide 15 [[Ancient Gear]]s, five [[Ancient Shaft]]s, and two [[Ancient Core]]s. They are the result of countless hours of research into [[Ancient Technology]] done by [[Robbie]]. This is common among many pieces of [[Ancient Soldier Gear]], the equipment archetype to which Ancient Spears belong. The spearhead glows and has incredible piercing power. Being made of Ancient Technology, Ancient Spears will deal additional damage when they are used against [[Guardian]]s. They will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, will float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and cannot burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_023" |Life = 50 |Power = 30 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.5 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 12 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 24 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 23 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 7 |BuyingPrice = 20 }} ==Trivia== * An unused icon and description for Ancient Spears exist within the files of {{AoC}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Ancient Spear Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Unused icon for an Ancient Spear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Soldier Gear * Ancient Technology * Ancient Weapon * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Spear}}
